events.title: Wormhole bridge exploit

research.summary: An attacker exploited Wormhole's Solana–Ethereum bridge and minted 120,000 wrapped ETH on Solana without equivalent backing, then moved assets across the bridge.
research.significance: The roughly $320 million incident became one of the defining bridge hacks and demonstrated the systemic danger of cross-chain asset representations.

events.title: Celsius freezes withdrawals

research.summary: Celsius paused all withdrawals, swaps and transfers between accounts, citing extreme market conditions.
research.significance: The freeze shattered the promise of instant access to high-yield crypto deposits and accelerated the 2022 centralized-lending panic.

events.title: Voyager Digital enters bankruptcy

research.summary: Voyager Digital commenced Chapter 11 restructuring after the crypto-market collapse and Three Arrows Capital default.
research.significance: Voyager's bankruptcy became a major retail-facing casualty of the 3AC credit contagion.

events.title: Nomad bridge exploit becomes a copycat free-for-all

research.summary: Nomad's bridge was drained in an exploit that became unusually open to copycats after users discovered they could reproduce a valid-looking withdrawal transaction with substituted recipient details.
research.significance: The Nomad hack became crypto's closest thing to a public looting event and one of the most memorable bridge failures.

events.title: BlockFi enters bankruptcy following FTX contagion

research.summary: BlockFi and several affiliates filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after the FTX collapse and its own withdrawal suspension.
research.significance: BlockFi's failure closed the loop on one of FTX's earlier 'rescue' relationships and became a key piece of 2022 credit contagion.

events.title: Sam Bankman-Fried is arrested

research.summary: Sam Bankman-Fried was arrested in the Bahamas on US criminal charges; an indictment was unsealed the following day alleging fraud, money laundering and other offenses.
research.significance: The arrest turned the FTX collapse from an insolvency story into one of the most consequential criminal cases in crypto history.

events.title: Luna Foundation Guard accumulates Bitcoin reserves

research.summary: The Luna Foundation Guard accumulated a large Bitcoin reserve intended to support UST; after the May crisis, its public reserve disclosure said only 313 BTC remained alongside other assets.
research.significance: The Bitcoin reserve strategy connected Terra directly to Bitcoin market risk and became a central part of the collapse narrative.

events.title: Harmony Horizon bridge is exploited

research.summary: Harmony's Horizon bridge was exploited after private keys were compromised, resulting in roughly $100 million of assets being stolen.
research.significance: The incident reinforced the danger of bridge designs secured by a small set of administrative keys.

events.title: BNB Chain bridge exploit triggers emergency chain response

research.summary: An exploit of BNB Chain's BSC Token Hub cross-chain bridge created roughly 2 million BNB; validators coordinated a temporary chain halt while the incident was contained.
research.significance: The event showed the security risk of native cross-chain bridges and the emergency-governance powers available on BNB Chain.

events.title: Mango Markets is manipulated and drained

research.summary: Avraham Eisenberg used highly leveraged Mango Markets positions and trades that sharply moved the MNGO oracle price, then withdrew more than $110 million in assets; the CFTC later alleged fraud and manipulation.
research.significance: The Mango episode became a landmark oracle-manipulation case and triggered an unusual public argument over whether exploitative market mechanics could be 'legal.'

events.title: CoinDesk reports on Alameda balance sheet

research.summary: CoinDesk reported details from a private Alameda Research balance sheet showing a large concentration of assets in FTT and other tokens linked to Sam Bankman-Fried's businesses.
research.significance: The report was the information shock that focused market attention on the financial interdependence between Alameda and FTX.

events.title: CZ says Binance will liquidate its FTT holdings

research.summary: Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao said Binance would liquidate its remaining FTT holdings, describing the move as post-exit risk management.
research.significance: The announcement accelerated scrutiny and selling pressure around FTT and became one of the most consequential social-media posts in crypto history.

sources.title: Archived CZ post — FTT liquidation statement

events.title: Binance signs and then abandons a deal to acquire FTX

research.summary: Binance announced a nonbinding letter of intent to acquire FTX.com after what it called a significant liquidity crunch, then withdrew from the deal the next day after due diligence and reports concerning customer funds and investigations.
research.significance: The failed rescue compressed FTX's collapse into public view and removed its most plausible emergency buyer.

events.title: LUNA death spiral

research.summary: As UST holders exited, Terra's mint/burn mechanism dramatically expanded LUNA supply while LUNA's price collapsed toward zero.
research.significance: The reflexive death spiral became the defining failure mode of algorithmic stablecoin design and erased tens of billions of dollars of market value.

events.title: Ethereum Merge

research.summary: Ethereum completed the Merge, replacing proof-of-work block production with proof-of-stake by joining mainnet execution to the Beacon Chain consensus system.
research.significance: The Merge was Ethereum's largest protocol transition and reduced the network's estimated energy consumption by roughly 99.95%.

events.title: FTX collapses and files for bankruptcy

research.summary: FTX Trading and more than 100 affiliated companies filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in Delaware. Sam Bankman-Fried resigned and restructuring specialist John J. Ray III took control.
research.significance: FTX's bankruptcy was one of the largest failures in crypto history and shattered confidence across exchanges, lenders, venture investors and regulators.
